need to import the root CA from our eDirectory tree, because this sever
is going to run Zenworks. We have the root CA from the tree, but it also

eDirectory?
Do I need to do some kind of CSR to create a private key for the machine
I'm trying to import the CA on?

Any help is appreciated. 

James
